usage: A 分鐘 (minute) is a unit of time that measures 60 seconds.
In Cantonese, 分鐘 usually follows a number to indicate how many minutes.
分鐘 can be used alone or combined with other time units like 小時 (hour).
It is common to hear 分鐘 used in daily conversations about time and schedules.
When asking or telling time duration, 分鐘 helps specify exactly how long.
